name: Itabashi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Itabashi ward emblem in white: a four-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Itabashi, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1952.

features.role: Itabashi ward emblem — a four-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character
